aggregation: One row per ISO-3 country/territory and Monday-start epidemiological week. Case/death rates are means of available OWID 7-day-smoothed per-million observations in that week. Vaccination and other cumulative/state indicators use the last non-missing source value within the week; no across-week imputation. Static covariates use the last non-missing source value within the week. Aggregates without ISO-3 codes and rows without continent are excluded.
